notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Be glad if you completed Vesper's Host for the new shiny drop at Banshee. You know what you were looking for, Envious Arsenal and Bait and Switch. If you expect either or both perks to get a nerf in the foreseeable future you should instead try to get your own roll of Cascade Point and Explosive Light for incredible burst DPS." Recommended MW: Velocity.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "The benefits of having a faster RPM and lower blast radius are a hindrance in PvP. You're looking to get 70 Blast radius to one shot all resilience levels, but this can't even get close without Explosive Light. You can prime targets easy with Danger Zone reducing self damage, and Chain Reaction for when you do secure a kill, earning yourself a little AoE damage." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 120 from 29 October 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3tLWOteO62mxx6Yh2Ll4k3?si=bb40d9918c564281) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for sustained damage against bosses in general and end-game, underleveled content. VS Chill Inhibitor is the first rapid fire Stasis heavy GL. The stats are excellent. At base, 59 Velocity equates to 52.26m/s, 25 Handling is 0.48s ready, 0.45s ADS speed and 0.43s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 29 is a 3.47s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserves, you have 34/36/38/39 total ammo. For the barrel perk, if you have Spike Grenades as your magazine Perk, Hard Launch squeezes a little extra damage as well as providing the biggest Velocity boost, otherwise Quick Launch and Smart Drift Control also work well. To get the most out of your magazine size, Augmented Drum or Mini Frags are decent magazine perk alternatives. The trait perk pairing of Envious Arsenal and Bait and Switch both proc on the same condition of damaging a target with your other weapons to reload the mag, and boost damage by ×1.3 for 10s. The Bray Legacy origin trait is useful in PvE, working in the background to add ability energy to the one closest to a full charge on every tick of weapon damage. Recommended MW: Velocity or Handling, with Quick Access Sling mod or Backup Mag mod to get to the maximum of 8 shots.
